description: Visual editor for TechDocs (MkDocs) pages, with the same Markdown fidelity as the Backstage plugin
config.openVisualByDefault: Open pages of a MkDocs `docs_dir` in the visual editor instead of the Markdown text. Use **Reopen Editor With…** to switch to the text.
config.images.maxSizeMB: Largest image, in MB, that the visual editor saves to the `assets` folder of the docs. Images go into the repository: large files weigh on every clone and on publishing.
